title: The Sleeping Agent: What Gist-Based Context Compression Loses and Why
abstract: arXiv:2608.11775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gist-based context compression---summarising older conversation history into compact representations---is a common approach in long-horizon language model agents, yet its effect on different types of memory retrieval is poorly understood. We use Salience-Weighted Consolidation (SWC), a biologically-inspired compression framework motivated by sleep-based memory consolidation, as a diagnostic probe to study when gist compression helps and when it hurts. SWC scores conversation history by salience, partitions it into priority tiers, and applies structured gist abstraction to mid-priority content. translated_title: 沉睡的代理：基于要点的上下文压缩损失了什么及原因
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11775v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于要点的上下文压缩——将较旧的对话历史总结为紧凑表示——是长时程语言模型代理中的常见方法，但其对不同类型记忆检索的影响尚不明确。我们使用显著性加权整合（SWC），一种受睡眠记忆巩固启发的生物模拟压缩框架，作为诊断探针来研究要点压缩何时有益、何时有害。SWC根据显著性对对话历史进行评分，将其划分为优先层级，并对中等优先级内容应用结构化要点抽象。在所有十个LoCoMo对话上评估四种条件——共1,935个匹配的纯文本问题，在排除第5类（对抗性）问题后，主要聚合中使用1,501个——在温度为0时，我们发现一致的任务类型交互效应：要点压缩在多跳推理和单跳事实性问答上显著优于截断。
tldr: 本文通过睡眠启发的SWC压缩框架发现，基于要点的上下文压缩在多跳推理和单跳事实问答上优于截断，但可能在其他记忆检索类型上造成损失。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a sleep-inspired SWC compression framework to reveal that gist-based context compression outperforms truncation on multi-hop reasoning and single-hop factual QA, yet may cause losses in other memory retrieval types.
